title: METAIS conformance driver response
description: The one JSON document a driver prints on standard output before exiting 0: the operation's result, or, for version, only the implementation's identity. Within the protocol's major version members are only added, and a runner ignores members it does not know.

ok.title: OK
ok.description: True when the operation completed and no finding is of error severity.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: The finding objects, in the specification's order.

listing.title: Listing
listing.description: For a dry run, the outputs the render would write; otherwise null or absent.
